styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Markets, murals and the old center.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Street grills, fritangas and strong coffee.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Volcano views and lake breezes nearby.

stays.why: Walk to the plaza, cathedral ruins and Puerto Salvador Allende; handy for buses and cheap eats.
Local neighborhood feel, markets and simple comedores; short taxi rides to the center.
Quieter, greener streets near embassies and malls; good for business and longer stays.
Modern hotels, malls and restaurants; easiest base if you have a car or plan day trips south.

food: Try a fritanga: a small local eatery serving grilled meat, fried cheese, plantains and gallo pinto.
Vigorón is a cheap classic: cabbage salad, chicharrón and yuca on a banana leaf.
Mercado Oriental and Mercado Roberto Huembes are good for cheap meals and fruit; go with a local and keep valuables close.
Coffee is a local pride: ask for a café de olla or a strong drip coffee at a market stall.
Seafood and lake fish appear on menus; ask what is fresh that day and check the price first.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for the Masaya volcano and craft market; go with a driver or tour and check opening hours on the day.
Add a day trip to Granada's colonial streets and the lake islets, about an hour south by road.
Spend a morning at the Museo Nacional and the old cathedral area, then lunch at Puerto Salvador Allende.

recommend.why: One night covers the old center, a market meal and the lakefront; add a night for a volcano or Granada day trip.

month_notes: Dry and hot: highs near 32°C, few rainy days. Good for walking the center.
Dry and hot, highs near 33°C. Carry water and plan shade breaks.
Hottest dry month, highs near 34°C. Start sightseeing early.
Very hot, highs near 35°C, with a few more rainy days. Pace yourself.
Rains arrive: about 20 rainy days and highs near 33°C. Pack a rain jacket.
Wet season: about 25 rainy days, highs near 30°C. Expect afternoon downpours.
Wet and warm, highs near 31°C, about 21 rainy days. Keep plans flexible.
Wet month, about 24 rainy days. Short showers are common.
Wettest month, about 27 rainy days. Carry an umbrella and waterproof bag.
Still very wet, about 27 rainy days, highs near 30°C.
Rains ease: about 18 rainy days, highs near 30°C.
Drier and slightly cooler, highs near 31°C, about 8 rainy days. A good month to visit.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical and hot all year, with a sharp dry season from December to April and a long wet season from May to October.

items.title: Best time: December to March
items.text: Highs around 31–33°C with only a few rainy days. Best for walking and day trips.

items.title: Hottest: March and April
items.text: Highs near 34–35°C. Sightsee early morning and rest in the shade at midday.

items.title: Wet season: May to October
items.text: Rain on 20–27 days a month. Showers are often heavy but short; plan indoor stops.

items.title: Wettest: September and October
items.text: About 27 rainy days each. Carry an umbrella and a waterproof bag for phones.

items.title: Warm nights
items.text: Lows stay around 23–25°C all year. Air-conditioning or a fan helps at night.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light breathable clothes, a hat and sunscreen; a rain jacket in the wet months; modest clothes for churches.

transit.best: Taxis for most trips; cheap numbered buses if you know the route and travel by day.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail in the city.
Numbered city buses are cheap (about C$2.50) but stop early; no night service. Bus 266 runs from Mercado Oriental to the airport along Carretera Norte.
Taxis are collective or private; agree the fare first. No Uber, and ride apps are limited, so book by phone or through your hotel.
Driving is congested and addresses use landmarks, not street numbers. Useful for day trips; check insurance and parking.
Fine downtown and at Puerto Salvador Allende by day. Cycling is for the bold.
